fixed: In a dance imported from The Caller's Box, a balance line that says more than the balance, such as "Balance long wave in center and slide left" after "form long wave", now keeps its other words ("and slide left") as a note on the wave. Before, they were lost when the balance was joined to the wave. A balance line that names a different wave, such as "Balance short wave in center" after a long wave, now stays as written.

The Caller's Box adapter's trailing balance-wave fold keeps what an undecoded custom balance-wave line says after its balance phrase (`[dancer] balance [the|a] [long|short|ocean] wave[s] [of four] [in the center]`) as the folded figure's note. A line whose phrase names a wave the figure is not (`short` on a long wave, `in center` on a wave of four), whose head is not that phrase, or whose rest is longer than `kMaxClauseNote`, refuses the fold and stays custom.
